notes.title: Because the review has not been approved yet, it has to be postponed
notes.content:
At the beginning, I filled out the wrong grading questionnaire, so the review indicated that I did not find any adult content in the game.

I filled out the grading questionnaire again without any updated documents, indicating that the situation has been resubmitted for review. However, I still don't know if the review will take another week, so the software release has been postponed.
